About The Wellness Way Supplies

One place for every Wellness Way facility to get the supplies it uses every day, branded with The Wellness Way, sourced and quality-checked by one supplier, and shipped straight to the facility.

HOW IT
WORKS

The Wellness Way Supplies is for Wellness Way facility staff only. Membership by invitation: ordering is behind a member login, so the catalog and order form are not public.

01

Membership by invitation

Facility accounts are set up by invitation. Invitation process [TBD].

02

Log In

Members log in to the portal to see the catalog, specs and packaging.

03

Order

Add products to the cart and submit an order for your facility.

04

Shipped to You

Orders ship from our warehouse. Lead times [TBD].

HOW WE
DELIVER

How we deliver

From Factory to Your Facility

The Wellness Way Supplies handles the work between the factory and your facility:

  • Samples sent for approval before every production run
  • Third-party inspection before shipment
  • Warehouse storage of approved stock
  • Orders shipped out to Wellness Way facilities
  • Packaging developed for the brand (printed bags, color boxes or labels)
